messages:
amy_customer: Hey @support — my org shows 500 trial credits but after hitting the text-gen endpoint a bunch of times our balance is still 500. Responses are 200 OK and contain usage fields, but the dashboard and /v1/account/credits show no decrement. Demo tomorrow, urgent. Example curl + response below.

amy_customer: ```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-***' \n  -d '{"model":"rwd-small-1","prompt":"hello","max_tokens":50}'

# response:
{
  "id":"res_01H...",
  "choices":[...],
  "usage":{"prompt_tokens":12,"completion_tokens":38,"total_tokens":50}
}
```

sarah_support: Thanks for reporting — sorry this is blocking. Can you DM me the account id and the last 3 request IDs? Also quick Q: is the API key definitely the project-scoped key for that account (not a legacy org key)?

amy_customer: account id: acct_7789. Last request ids: res_01Habc123, res_01Hdef456, res_01Hghi789. Key is the project key created in console for acct_7789.

sarah_support: pinging billing and infra to investigate @oliver_billing @raj_backend — sending repro steps and headers.

sarah_support: Repro steps I have: 1) POST /v1/generate with project key 2) get 200 + usage in body 3) dashboard credits unchanged and no ledger entries.

oliver_billing: looking. I don't see ledger events for those request ids in the metering index. Can you paste the full response headers (the x-request-id and any x-usage headers if present)?

amy_customer: headers pasted: x-request-id: rq_9f2a, x-rw-env: prod, x-rate-limit-remaining: 999. No x-usage header.

raj_backend: quick thought — if the metering pipeline got duplicate idempotency keys we may have deduped the charge. But that would usually still show one decrement. I'm going to tail ingestion logs for acct_7789 now.

lisa_sre: I pulled traces for rq_9f2a -> api-gateway -> gen-service. Gen-service emitted a success and forwarded a metering event to the metering queue, but the metering-consumer logged an error: 

```
ERROR metering.consumer - failed to enqueue event: QueueFullError - backpressure triggered, dropping event (metadata x-rw-overlay present)
```

lisa_sre: Looks like during a short spike the consumer dropped some events when an optional header was present. That would result in no ledger entry even though the customer got a 200.

raj_backend: ah that header gating was part of the overlay rollout last week. We added a header check but didn't account for the QueueFull path. I'll open a hotfix to stop dropping and instead persist to disk for retry.

oliver_billing: For immediate help we can run a manual reconcile to create ledger rows from the gen-service audit logs. @billing-bot can you queue a reconcile for acct_7789 from 1768123000 to 1768124300?

billing-bot: reconcile job queued: job_9981. Estimated completion 45 minutes.

sarah_support: We can also provisionally credit the account so the demo isn't blocked — would you like us to apply 200 trial credits now while we reconcile? :thinking:

amy_customer: Please do, that would help. Thanks.

oliver_billing: Granting 200 trial credits now and flagging for reversal if reconcile shows they were legitimately consumed. I'll post once reconcile completes. :thumbsup:

raj_backend: Hotfix PR opened to avoid dropping; will deploy to prod in ~2h and add metric/alert for QueueFullError. Root cause: optional x-rw-overlay header caused a blocking path in our enqueue code when queue cap reached.

lisa_sre: Reconcile job update: job_9981 in progress, currently processing 12k events/sec window. Will emit ledger rows for missing events.

billing-bot: reconcile job_9981 complete: 3 missing events reconciled for acct_7789, ledger entries created for res_01Habc123, res_01Hdef456, res_01Hghi789. Total tokens applied: 150.

oliver_billing: Reconciliation succeeded — account acct_7789 should now show correct decremented balance (500 - 150 = 350). We applied provisional 200 credits earlier; we'll reverse the provisional grant and apply only net if needed. Final balance should be 350.

amy_customer: I see 350 now in the console. Thanks so much, huge relief.

sarah_support: Glad that fixed it — we'll follow up tomorrow with postmortem and ETA for hotfix deploy. Keeping this thread open until PR in prod.

raj_backend: PR deployed to prod, added safe-path for queue overflow and alert. Postmortem will include timeline and mitigations.

sarah_support: Closing loop — customer credited temporarily then reconciled; account corrected to 350. Reopen if anything else crops up. :white_check_mark:
